projects.title: Navigating the Complexities of Natural Language Inference with BERT
projects.description: Explore the intricate challenges of implementing Natural Language Inference (NLI) using the BERT model. This project delves into the nuances of language understanding, scrutinizing the assumptions and methods employed, while emphasizing the importance of external validation, iterative refinement, and transparency in responsible NLP model deployment.

projects.title: Workout Tracking API
projects.description: A backend for logging and managing workout routines and exercises. Built with Django and a MySQL Server database, this RESTful API stores and recalls your workout history so you can track progress over time.
